programme.desc: Young Mark McCain is eager to help lawman Jay Jefferson, who arrives in North Fork searching for a wanted outlaw. However, Jefferson is willing to kill an innocent man to claim the reward, whether he is the right man or not

programme.title: Rifleman S1E32 The Woman
programme.desc: When North Fork's schoolteacher, Adele Adams, tries to organize a women's suffrage movement, an unfounded rumour turns the townspeople against her, prompting a mob to drive her out of town.

programme.title: Alias the Badman
programme.desc: A classic Western adventure filled with mystery, danger, and suspense, as a mysterious outlaw's identity leads to trouble and a showdown in the Wild West.

programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole 1973
programme.desc: In The Brothers O’Toole, Tim Conway and John Astin star in a rollicking Western comedy of mistaken identity and small-town chaos. When two lookalike drifters stumble into a struggling frontier town, one is hailed as a hero while the other is branded an outlaw. Their misadventures set off a whirlwind of mix-ups, scams, and slapstick mayhem. With sharp wit, lively performances, and a playful twist on Western tradition, this offbeat comedy delivers laughs as big as the open range.

programme.title: The Gabby Hayes Show - Watchmaker
programme.desc: Dramatizing the lives of historical figures, such as the naval commander, the lawman and professional gambler, and the outlaw Belle, tall tales and Western scenes

programme.title: Blue Steel

programme.title: Drum Taps 1933
programme.desc: In Drum Taps, cowboy star Ken Maynard rides into action when a vicious gang threatens to overrun the frontier. With his trusty horse Tarzan at his side, he rallies ranchers and townsfolk alike to stand against lawlessness. Packed with galloping chases, blazing six-guns, and Maynard’s trademark heroics, this early sound Western delivers classic thrills straight from the saddle.

programme.title: Ridin' the Cherokee Trail 1941
programme.desc: In Ridin’ the Cherokee Trail, Tex Ritter sings and rides into a frontier torn by corruption and outlaw rule. When a gang of schemers threatens to take control of a vital stage line, Tex steps in with his six-gun, courage, and a song to rally the people. Blending fast-paced action, trailblazing heroics, and Ritter’s trademark melodies, this Western delivers justice on the open range.
